# Commands manual worktrees and one-time Codex history transfer

`commands/graph/manual-worktrees.mjs` and `commands/graph/client/worktrees.js` add registered worktree listing, creation/deletion, alternate checkout, management UI, indicators, and folder `vscode://file/...` links. `desktop/main.cjs` already accepts those links. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
